violations.msg: The PVDD 'soft-start' does not limit inrush: C2 (220 nF) is gate-SOURCE, so it only delays turn-on (tau ~ 32k x 220 nF = 7 ms); once Vgs crosses threshold the AO4485 (gfs ~25-30 S, Crss ~180 pF gives negligible Miller feedback) slews 440+ uF to 20 V in well under 1 ms, an estimated 20-40 A peak drawn from the PD source, which can trip the charger OCP (VBUS drop, whole board resets) every time firmware enables PVDD and stresses Q1 SOA; move the cap gate-to-DRAIN (Miller soft-start, e.g. 10-22 nF + ~1k series) so dV/dt ~ 2 V/ms (~1 A inrush).

TPA3118 SDZ (pin 2) is driven straight from ESP32 GPIO21: abs-max table limits SDZ to 10 V/ms slew (note 2: 100 kohm series resistor required if exceeded) and to PVCC+0.3 V, which a 3.3 V high violates whenever PVDD is off (Q1 open) - add a series resistor and re-scale the 100k pull-down (100k/100k would put SDZ at 1.65 V < VIH 2 V).

SMBJ24A clamps at 38.9 V (VBR min 26.7 V), above the 30 V abs-max of TPS54302 VIN and TPA3118 PVCC and the 25 V rating of C3/C4, so the TVS protects nothing on VBUS against a 20 V overshoot; it only catches gross surges after the ICs are already over-stressed.

TPS54302 input caps are 10 uF/25 V X5R 0805 on a 21 V rail: DC-bias derating leaves roughly 1.5-2.5 uF each, below TI's 'ceramic over 10 uF' (design example uses 35 V parts), with no voltage margin for ringing - use 50 V 1206/1210 parts.

Q1's body diode (drain=PVDD to source=VBUS) back-feeds the 440 uF PVDD bulk into VBUS whenever VBUS falls (PD hard reset, 20->5 V renegotiation, source-side vSafe0V discharge) and PVDD has no bleeder, so VBUS is held up and the source must discharge the amp bulk; a hard reset may not reach vSafe0V in tSafe0V.

PVDD is switched by GPIO18 (PVDD_EN), not by CH224Q PG as architecture/blocks.md B2 states (the pin map even lists GPIO18 as unused); the 'amp never powered from a 5 V-only port' guarantee is firmware-only (must check PD_PG/VBUS_SENSE first) - document it or add a hardware AND with PG.

LP5907 output carries 1 uF + 10 uF + 2 x 100 nF = 11.2 uF nominal, above the datasheet stability range COUT 0.7-10 uF (SNVS798 sec 5.6); only DC-bias derating of the 10 uF/10 V 0603 keeps it borderline - drop C32 to 4.7 uF or move it before the LDO.

No ESD protection on the user-facing USB-C data and CC lines (USB_DP/USB_DM to CH340C, CC1/CC2 to CH224Q); a product board needs a low-capacitance array (e.g. USBLC6-2 class) at J1 or an explicit waiver.
Ceramic capacitance on VBUS at attach (~15-21 uF at 5 V) exceeds the Type-C/PD sink cSnkBulk 10 uF limit; minor, but it adds attach inrush on strict sources.

CH224Q CFG2/SCL and CFG3/SDA have internal 7-15 kohm pull-ups to an undocumented internal rail; if that rail is ~5 V the bus idles near 3.6 V (2.2k to 3.3 V in parallel), at the ESP32 VDD+0.3 V limit - measure at bring-up with R2/R3 fitted (they are 0R links, depopulate if high).

PVDD bulk RVT 220 uF/35 V is rated only 195 mA ripple at 120 Hz; a 2 x 43 W BTL stage with bass content and a current-limited PD source pushes amps of low-frequency ripple through these caps - pick a low-ESR/high-ripple polymer or larger can.

Gain staging: ES8388 full scale is 1 Vrms, so at 26 dB the amp reaches 20 Vrms vs ~13 Vrms clip at 20 V/4 ohm - it hard-clips 3.7 dB below 0 dBFS (and the analog bypass from line-in also overdrives); firmware must cap codec volume or use 20 dB (5.6k, R51 open).
White LED (Vf 2.6-3.1 V) from a 3.3 V GPIO through 1k gives 0.2-0.6 mA, not the 1.3 mA the role claims; a high-Vf part may be barely visible - use ~220-330 ohm or a lower-Vf colour.

IR receiver on GPIO39 and vol- button on GPIO36 (SENSOR_VN/VP): ESP32 errata 3.11 - these inputs glitch low ~80 ns when ADC1/Wi-Fi RTC peripherals power up, giving false edge interrupts; firmware must filter (RMT filter / debounce) or move IR to a normal GPIO.

Every library pin is typed 'passive', so the 0/0 ERC pass checks only connectivity: no power-input-not-driven, output-to-output or output-to-rail conflicts can be detected; the netlist was hand-verified here instead.
